title: Nexora Client Proposal
description: Core machine-readable model for a Nexora Client Proposal / Commercial Schedule. This is a commercial document model, NOT a legal contract. It models the Proposal and the approved commercial record that governs invoicing. Authoritative pricing is never stored here — it resolves from ops/billing-source-of-truth.json via ops/proposals/package-mapping.json (see validate-proposals.mjs). All prices are in GBP. VAT is UNDETERMINED and must never be asserted. Enforcement subset: ops/proposals/validate-proposals.mjs.

proposal_id.description: Unique proposal reference, e.g. PRP-2026-0018 (format aligned with invoice.example.json). Generator-assigned; not a commercial change.

version.description: Proposal version, e.g. 1.0, 1.1. An accepted proposal is immutable; revisions get a new version / proposal_id (see README).

status.description: Proposal lifecycle status. CLIENT_ACCEPTED freezes the commercial schedule.

valid_until.description: issue_date + proposal_validity_days (30) from ops/billing-source-of-truth.json invoice_terms. Distinct from invoice due date (7 calendar days).

reference_price.description: PUBLIC / BASE REFERENCE price (From or fixed) resolved from billing-source-of-truth.json. Web/Brand only. NOT the contractual price. Must be absent for COMPLETE (bespoke, no public price) and AI (no single package price).

approved_final_project_price.description: APPROVED FINAL PROJECT PRICE. Client-specific, approved, recorded. This governs invoicing (INVOICE-FLOW.md §5), NOT the public From price. May legitimately differ from reference_price for From/bespoke offerings.

setup_fee.description: AI implementation fee (A1 £497, A2 £997, A3 From £1,995). Null/absent for Web/Brand/Care (no separate setup fee).

payment_schedule.description: Milestone percentages. Must match the frozen schedule for standard packages; B3 is a recorded per-proposal schedule (sums to 100); COMPLETE is 30/30/30/10. AI/Care: not governed — null.

recurring_fees.description: AI: monthly fee (A1 £297, A2 £697, A3 From £1,495) starting at GO_LIVE. Care: monthly in advance. Web/Brand packages without Care: null.

code.description: Care plan: WEB_CARE_ESSENTIAL / WEB_CARE_PLUS / BRAND_CARE_STANDARD / BRAND_CARE_EXTENDED.

care.description: Optional Care. Monthly in advance, no indefinite rollover, separately identifiable from the project price (never bundled).

warranty.description: The only supported warranty claim is the governed 90-day Web Launch Warranty (qualifying delivery defects; not Care/maintenance/new scope).

status.description: VAT is UNRESOLVED. No rate, registration, included/excluded assertion may be made (see ops/billing-source-of-truth.json vat and the Constitution §10).

method.description: Provider-neutral acceptance method (written / signed PDF / e-sign placeholders). No provider is configured.

provider.description: E-SIGNATURE PROVIDER — OWNER DECISION REQUIRED. Null until chosen.

_example.description: Fixture marker. MUST be true on any committed example/instance so a real client proposal is never committed by mistake.
